processing.aggregation: Day-weighted annual mean of 12 complete monthly Level-3 composite values; incomplete years excluded.
processing.scaling: Use exported physical values as returned; no second application of MODIS integer scale factor.
processing.quality: Fill −9999 and negative values excluded. Export supplies no monthly retrieval-count or pixel QA columns. Clear-sky sampling, clouds and retrieval uncertainty remain limitations.
processing.uncertainty: OLS with calendar-year Newey–West HAC lag 1, Bartlett weights, n/(n−2) correction and Student-t inference. October 2022 is fill, excluding 2022; HAC pairs only adjacent calendar years and does not bridge this gap. Residual-lag diagnostic is consecutive retained observations. Not measurement error, causal evidence, night-only data, current air quality, lighting or naked-eye visibility. Selectable windows are exploratory, with no multiplicity adjustment. This product differs from POWER/CERES SYN1deg; do not splice or treat their differences as temporal changes.
